name: Phonebook
about: For instance, my Phonebook project. For it I drew inspiration from an image I admired, extracted its colors and integrated them into the overall layout. With this Phonebook app, you can add names and phone numbers, perform a quick search, and delete entries as needed.
notes: But I also like creating UI designs of different styles and color schemes.

name: To Do List
about: It all started with a simple To-Do List project. In this application, you can add and delete tasks and lists, as well as mark tasks as important and completed. All data is stored in Local Storage.
notes: You might have noticed that I love neon colors and dark themes.

name: Music Box
about: Take this music search app, for example. You can look up songs, see their artist, album cover, and release date, listen to a preview, and copy a link to share your favorite tracks.
notes: At some point I really got into exploring full-stack and backend development. I built the backend for some of my projects and had fun deploying them to Heroku and later to Render.

name: Streaming App (WIP)
about: This app lets you log in with your GitHub account, listen to tracks, and manage playlists — create, edit, and delete them as you like.
notes: I like retrowave, synthwave, and electronic music, which led me to create a Streaming App project where you can listen to it.

name: Browser game "Escaping Duck"
about: A browser game where you play as a duck racing forward, dodging obstacles, collecting bonuses, and gathering the letters "HYPER" to escape. The fun twist: your microphone input affects your speed, so you can literally shout your way forward.
notes: I love playing video games, and this project was my chance to experiment with new technologies.

name: Pixel Art Board
about: Users can choose a canvas size and paint using different color palettes or a custom color picker. They can also upload an image to paint over, and download their artwork as a PNG.
notes: One of the recent projects I made is a pixel drawing app built with Next.js and React.
